title: AFP, PNP personnel cited for securing BARMM parliament inaugural session

blocks.text: COTABATO CITY – The Philippine Army’s 6th Infantry (Kampilan) Division and Joint Task Force Central (JTFC) on Wednesday recognized soldiers and police officers who spearheaded security operations during the historic opening of the first elected Bangsamoro parliament and the election of the region’s first chief minister. The event was graced by President Ferdinand R. Marcos
